other_conditions: Applicant must belong to one of the tribal communities recognized by the state of Arunachal Pradesh
Applicant must be legally residing in the Changlang, Lohit, or Namsai districts of Arunachal Pradesh
Applicant must be a member of a backward community
If the applicant is employed by the state government, the scheme’s benefits are also available to their dependents
benefits_summary: Provides cashless coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year, including pre‑ and post‑hospitalization expenses.
